# REST API

Every endpoint the server exposes, indexed from [`api/openapi.yaml`](../../api/openapi.yaml).

Every route takes its namespace from `X-Memini-Namespace`; the caller's personal namespace travels in `X-Memini-Home`.

## Memories

The core read and write surface. `POST /v1/search` is the REST equivalent of `memory_recall`.

| Endpoint | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `DELETE /v1/memories` | Delete every memory in the namespace carrying a tag |
| `DELETE /v1/memories/{id}` | Forget (delete) a memory |
| `GET /v1/memories` | List memories in a namespace (backs the admin UI browser) |
| `GET /v1/memories/{id}` | Fetch a memory by ID |
| `GET /v1/memories/{id}/history` | The full version chain (supersession lineage) of a memory |
| `POST /v1/answer` | Recall memories and answer a question grounded on them (requires an LLM) |
| `POST /v1/memories` | Remember (store) a memory |
| `POST /v1/memories/{id}/reassign` | Move a single memory to a different namespace |
| `POST /v1/memories/{id}/supersede` | Tombstone a memory, recording it was replaced by `by`. |
| `POST /v1/search` | Recall memories via hybrid (vector + keyword) search |

## Namespaces and scoping

Inspect and repair how memories are partitioned.

| Endpoint | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `DELETE /v1/links` | Delete a namespace link |
| `DELETE /v1/namespaces` | Delete every memory in the request namespace |
| `GET /v1/links` | List outgoing namespace links from the request namespace |
| `GET /v1/namespaces` | List the distinct namespaces holding memories |
| `GET /v1/namespaces/briefing` | Layered session-start briefing for the request namespace |
| `GET /v1/namespaces/read-set` | Resolve the structural read-set for the request namespace |
| `POST /v1/links` | Create or replace a namespace link (cross-namespace read edge) |
| `POST /v1/namespaces/move` | Relocate every memory in the request namespace to another namespace |
| `POST /v1/namespaces/split` | Split the request namespace by metadata keys |

## Maintenance

Run hygiene passes on demand rather than waiting for the background schedule.

| Endpoint | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /v1/activity` | Recent memory activity — what was served or written, and why |
| `GET /v1/stats` | Per-namespace overview (counts by tier, accesses, importance) |
| `POST /v1/dedup` | Collapse near-duplicate memories (vector cluster) — tombstone the lower-scored members of each cluster |
| `POST /v1/fsck` | Run a consistency sweep (purge expired, enforce short-term cap, audit duplicates) |

## API keys

Requires the admin key (`MEMINI_API_KEY`).

| Endpoint | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `DELETE /v1/keys/{name}` | Delete an API key |
| `GET /v1/keys` | List API keys (name/home/default namespace/created/disabled/source — never a secret or hash) |
| `PATCH /v1/keys/{name}` | Update an API key's home namespace, default namespace, and/or disabled state |
| `POST /v1/keys` | Create a new API key, returning its secret exactly once |
| `POST /v1/keys/{name}/rotate` | Rotate an API key's secret, returning the new secret exactly once |

## Operational

Health, readiness, and Prometheus metrics endpoints.

| Endpoint | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /healthz` | Liveness probe |
| `GET /metrics` | Prometheus metrics |
| `GET /readyz` | Readiness probe (verifies storage backend) |
